title: One phone event from a Shortcuts personal automation (POST /ingest/event)
description: arrive and leave need place and take no focus; focus_on and focus_off need focus and take no place; alarm_stopped and wake take neither. The service checks these rules in code.

place.description: A name the phone's geofence stands for. Coordinates never leave the phone

at.description: ISO 8601 with an offset, from Shortcuts' Current Date
